title: Synthesis and Characterization of Copper Nanoparticles through Chemical and Electrochemical Methods
content: A particle with all three dimensions measuring between 1 nm and 100 nm is considered a nanoparticle. Due to its scale, it exhibits unique properties compared to its larger counterpart, including a high surface-to-volume ratio. This enhanced ratio improves its interaction with bacterial membranes, contributing to its antimicrobial properties [1].
